principle: The catalog is an internal diagnostic ontology, not a questionnaire. Only authority-gated unresolved intents become visible primary questions.

intents.name: conversation_reason
intents.objective: Understand the explicit subject, problem, change or decision brought to the call.
suppress_if: booking already states the concrete trigger/reason sufficiently for the call

intents.name: technical_or_service_scope
intents.objective: Bound the exact system, environment, control surface, framework or workload relevant to the engagement.
suppress_if: scope is already explicit enough to select the correct review boundary

intents.name: current_state
intents.objective: Establish only the current controls/process/architecture needed to diagnose an admitted problem or scope.
suppress_if: governed public evidence already answers the relevant current-state fact
current state would be generic maturity discovery
listen_for_examples: we already use SSO and SCIM
we have a Trust Center but still answer custom spreadsheets

intents.name: problem_or_gap
intents.objective: Locate the confirmed friction, uncertainty, failure or undesired condition.
intents.conditional_authority: A prospect answer may open D04 when it explicitly introduces a problem, gap, concern or observed behavior.
suppress_if: no prospect evidence of a problem and the call is purely preventive/validation-oriented
listen_for_examples: we keep rewriting the same questionnaire
we are unsure our token boundary is correct

intents.name: implication
intents.objective: Understand the consequence of a prospect-confirmed problem without manufacturing pain.
intents.conditional_authority: Only after the prospect explicitly introduces a problem, delay, cost, deal impact, risk or operational burden.
suppress_if: no confirmed problem/consequence exists
question would be generic SPIN-style pain fishing
listen_for_examples: security engineers lose hours per review
we cannot close remediation before code freeze

intents.name: desired_outcome
intents.objective: Define the result, decision, artifact or operating change the prospect wants.
suppress_if: the required deliverable and acceptance condition are already explicit

intents.name: prior_attempts
intents.objective: Learn what has already been tried only when that changes diagnosis or avoids repeating failed work.
intents.conditional_authority: A prospect answer may open D07 when they mention prior work, an incumbent, previous test or attempted fix.
suppress_if: asking would be generic history-taking with no effect on next action
listen_for_examples: our current consultant only handles compliance

intents.name: constraints_dependencies
intents.objective: Identify a prospect-confirmed technical, contractual, regulatory or delivery constraint that changes feasible scope.
intents.conditional_authority: A prospect answer may open D08 by naming a constraint or dependency.
suppress_if: constraint is hypothetical or inferred from public research
listen_for_examples: cannot change auth flow before launch

intents.name: ownership_stakeholders
intents.objective: Clarify implementation, evidence or decision ownership only when unresolved ownership affects the next move.
suppress_if: booking already identifies the relevant owner
stakeholder mapping would be generic qualification

intents.name: economics
intents.objective: Collect direct commercial evidence only when the prospect or consultant policy authorizes it.
suppress_if: budget policy is off and prospect has not introduced economics
public company size/funding is the only basis

intents.name: timing_trigger
intents.objective: Resolve a prospect-introduced deadline, milestone or timing dependency.
suppress_if: timing is already sufficiently explicit
asking 'why now' would be generic

intents.name: decision_process
intents.objective: Understand evaluation/approval mechanics only when the prospect or consultant policy makes them consequential.
suppress_if: decision process is generic procurement fishing
no next-step decision depends on it yet
listen_for_examples: CTO signs off after security review

intents.name: assurance_requirements
intents.objective: Define a prospect-introduced customer, auditor, framework or evidence requirement.
intents.conditional_authority: A prospect answer may open D13 by explicitly introducing customers, questionnaires, audits, evidence or assurance requirements.
suppress_if: public compliance facts are the only basis
no external assurance requirement has been introduced

intents.name: delivery_fit
intents.objective: Determine assessment vs implementation vs advisory vs ongoing support after problem/scope/outcome evidence exists.
suppress_if: service shape is being selected before scope/outcome is known
listen_for_examples: we need a one-off independent test

intents.name: next_move
intents.objective: Choose the smallest correct post-call action once enough diagnostic and policy evidence exists.
suppress_if: core admitted dimensions remain unresolved
